title: The Azure Remembrance Canon
summary: A canon of a clear remembrance that holds the past entire and can unmake a single memory in a foe as cleanly as it keeps its own.

title: Treatise of the Skysworn Mindkeeping
summary: A treatise of the cultivation-side order on keeping the mind whole under any probe and turning the probe back on the prober.

title: The Sapphire Chronicle Mastery
summary: A mastery of an annal kept in the mind in blue ink that can strike a single hour out of the record of a foe's life.

title: Canon of the Unforgetting Sky
summary: A canon of a sky that forgets nothing that passed under it and lets all of that memory fall on a field at once.

title: The Pledge-Tempered Memory Canon
summary: A canon of a memory tempered by pledges kept and broken that can erase the pledge-breaker's knowledge of the pledge.

title: Treatise of the Storm-Etched Recollection
summary: A treatise of a recollection etched into the mind by storms so deeply that the etching can be drawn out and cut into another.

title: The Gale Remembrance Mastery
summary: A full mastery of remembrance in the manner of the Gale that rides the wind of the past and seals what it finds there.

title: Manual of the Sworn Unforgetting
summary: A manual for the sworn who vow never to forget and who bind that vow into the mind of every comrade who shares it.
